text: I've helped with the herds since I could walk fast enough to keep up.
Ena is teaching me to spot sick animals before they show obvious signs.
Roka trusts me to run messages he wouldn't trust to just anyone my age.
Cattle refuse to graze near a certain stretch of the Old Canal Bed, and I've never seen a good reason why.
Fen told me he found old foundations buried in that same stretch.
Noki says the canal gates near there need constant repair too.
Three of us, from three different jobs, all circling the same patch of ground without meaning to.
I haven't told an adult about comparing notes like this. I don't think they'd take it seriously.
I've seen the archive-keeper walking near the pastures sometimes, alone.
I want to ask her about it, but I'm a little afraid to.
The old herders tell the Turning differently depending on how old they were when it happened.
The ones who were children then tell it calmer than the ones who were adults.
Someday I want a herd of my own, and I want to know this land properly before I get it.
